== 
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Md. Helal Ahmad, Advocate
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Uday Pratap Singh, A.P.P.
 Mr. Nk Sinha, Advocate
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Prabhat Kumar Singh
 Oral Order
7 09-08-2024

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, State and opposite party no.2.
2.
The petitioner seeks regular bail in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 498A/323 of the Indian Penal Code and sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the parties have resolved their dispute in terms of settlement mutually agreed upon by them.
A copy of the settlement is annexed with the mediator's report dated 10.5.2024.
4. Learned counsel for opposite party no.2 does not controvert the submission of the learned counsel for the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.73075 of 2023(7) dt.09-08-2024 petitioner.
5. Considering the mediator's report, prayer for bail of the petitioner is allowed.

In the event of arrest/surrender within six weeks from today, let the petitioner, mentioned above, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Judicial Magistrate 1st class, Purnea in Complaint Case No. 195 of 2022,
